facts.fact: Kenya is named with Uganda, Rwanda and South Sudan as a partner state in the Northern Corridor Integration Projects, whose implementation clusters meeting in Kampala discussed a single digital market, roaming costs and a joint communications satellite study; the report is dated 2026-08-24 and gives no date for the meeting.

Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan opened a joint account at Standard Chartered Bank Uganda to receive partner-state contributions for a satellite feasibility study agreed under a roadmap settled at an April 2026 Nairobi meeting; the source dates the account only to its report of 2026-08-24, and says the study has not yet started pending deposits.

systems.owner: Partner states Uganda, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan
